title: Exchange of park property.
bodyText: The counties may accept from or transfer to the State, park lands, which may include related improvements, personnel, equipment, and functions.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Transfer of parks between State and counties. L 1988, c 7 repealing L 1984, c 34; L 1991, c 312.

annotations.heading: Cross References
annotations.text:
Aina Hoomalu, see §184-31.
State provisions, see §184-3.

bodyHtml:
[§46-65.5]  Exchange of park property.  The counties may accept from or transfer to the State, park lands, which may include related improvements, personnel, equipment, and functions. [L 1987, c 335, §3]

 

Note

 

  Transfer of parks between State and counties.  L 1988, c 7 repealing L 1984, c 34; L 1991, c 312.

 

Cross References

 

  Aina Hoomalu, see §184-31.

  State provisions, see §184-3.
